positions.name: VerifiedCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the current verified state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration?
positions.why: All three expressions report the same settled fact from two angles — the prose narrates the calibration as completed and verified against the June reference plates, holding across the observing band, while the two field-labels restate the instrument identity and the calibration figure/verification basis in structured catalogue form. Register and affect readings agree across all three (calm-positive, flat technical/matter-of-fact), and conviction stays level (plain unhedged claim, no escalation to decision) — no tension, just the same verified-status read performed twice, once as report and once as record.
